# Canadian.lk

> Sri Lanka's trusted gateway to higher education, student loans up to CAD $65,000, and study permits in Canada.

Canadian.lk connects Sri Lankan students with verified Canadian university partners, facilitating direct university admissions, student loans through leading commercial banks, and comprehensive study permit assistance through RCIC-licensed immigration consultants.

## Core Pathways & Services

- [Home](https://www.canadian.lk/): Overview of Canadian education pathways and loan limits.
- [About Us](https://www.canadian.lk/about): Mission, trust framework, and Canadian partner network.
- [Services](https://www.canadian.lk/services): University admissions, educational financing up to CAD $65,000, and visa support.
- [In-Demand Programs](https://www.canadian.lk/programs): Healthcare, IT, engineering, and trades programs in Canada with PGWP eligibility.
- [The Flight Plan](https://www.canadian.lk/flight-plan): 5-step roadmap from initial consultation in Colombo to landing in Canada.
- [Apply Now](https://www.canadian.lk/apply): Online application portal to check loan eligibility and submit academic transcripts.
- [Contact](https://www.canadian.lk/contact): Contact information, office location in Colombo, and consultation booking.
